description: This file implements the methods and classes for MockPersistentReportingStore, a mock class used for testing reporting store operations in the Chromium project. It defines command classes, operator overloads, and methods to simulate loading, adding, updating, deleting, and verifying reporting endpoints and groups.

classes.name: MockPersistentReportingStore::Command
classes.description: Represents a command in the mock reporting store, with various constructors for different command types, and operator overloads for comparison and output.

methods.name: MockPersistentReportingStore::Command
methods.description: Constructors for creating command instances with specific types and associated data.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two Command objects based on type and relevant data.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two Command objects.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a textual representation of a Command object to an ostream.

methods.name: MockPersistentReportingStore
methods.description: Default constructor and destructor for the mock reporting store.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Simulates loading reporting clients and stores the callback.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint command to the command list.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Adds a reporting endpoint group command.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the access time for a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: DeleteReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Deletes a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: DeleteReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Deletes a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes the current commands, updating endpoint counts.

methods.name: SetPrestoredClients
methods.description: Sets pre-stored clients and groups for testing.

methods.name: FinishLoading
methods.description: Completes the loading process, invoking the callback with stored data.

methods.name: VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies that the command list matches expected commands.

methods.name: CountCommands
methods.description: Counts the number of commands of a specific type.

methods.name: ClearCommands
methods.description: Clears all stored commands.

methods.name: GetAllCommands
methods.description: Returns the list of all stored commands.
